reasons.plausibility: Substituting Ta with Nb is chemically reasonable and likely to reduce density, but the assumption that solid-solution strengthening will be fully maintained is uncertain because Ta and Nb have different atomic sizes and moduli, which can alter strength, especially at 1000 °C.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes specific measurements and a quantitative rejection criterion, though the 5–10% strength loss threshold is somewhat arbitrary and creep/oxidation effects at 1000 °C are mentioned but not integrated into the falsification test.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the core trade-off directly with a simple, actionable substitution, making it a practical starting point for experimental work on this alloy system.
